sections.title: Sound of letter G
paragraphs: You name this letter (G) /dʒ/. It usually makes the sound you hear in (game) /ɡeɪm/, which means an activity for fun. It makes four sounds in English words.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: For the first sound, press the back of your tongue against the soft roof of your mouth. Stop the air, drop your tongue, and turn your voice on. For the second sound, touch behind your upper teeth, stop the air, and push it out with voice. For the third sound, blow smooth voice through a narrow gap behind the teeth. Touch your throat to feel it shake.

sections.title: Spelling rules
paragraphs: Before the letters a, o or u, before another consonant, or at word end, say the sound in (gas) /ɡæs/. Often before the letters e, i or y, say the sound in (gem) /dʒɛm/. In some loan words before e or i, make the softer sound in (genre) /ʒɒn.rə/. It is a silent letter before the letter n, as in (sign) /saɪn/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not turn the voiced sound into a voiceless one at the end of a word. When you say (dog) /dɒɡ/, keep your voice on. Do not let it sound like the word dock. When you see this letter before the letter n in (gnat) /næt/, do not pronounce it at all.
